subject: Renewal review & latency uptick — ForgeAI
content:
From: Lucas Mercer <lucas@forgeai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion + recent latency uptick

Hi Jasmine,

We’re nearing the end of our annual term with Redwood and I wanted to get a quick read on two things before we talk renewal: 1) we saw a noticeable p95 latency jump for generation requests over the last two weeks (attached p95 graph), and 2) our token spend for June is ~38% above our projection — curious whether that was expected given the model mix.

High level asks: can you share a brief ROI recap tied to our usage (token mix, model choice) and a renewal recommendation that would help cap latency and give us headroom for the product launch in Q4?

Thanks,
Lucas
Product Ops, ForgeAI

---

On Mon, 01 Jul 2028 at 15:05 Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Lucas Mercer <lucas@forgeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + recent latency uptick

Hi Lucas — thanks for the note and for the attachments. Tagging Ben (CS lead) for the usage/ROI side and Monica (finance/renewal) for terms.

Short answer up front: we can propose a renewal structure that lowers unit cost through committed capacity while adding a latency SLA and reserved burst capacity for launch windows. I’ll pull together a short two-page recap: June token breakdown, model mix impact, and three renewal scenarios (conservative, growth, launch-ready).

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync this week to review the recap and align on KPIs (target p95, max monthly spend tolerance). Ben — can you bring the burst-capacity options and an ops remediation plan for the p95 spike? Monica — will prepare a couple term/discount permutations.

Best,
Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

On Tue, 02 Jul 2028 at 10:20 Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Lucas Mercer <lucas@forgeai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + recent latency uptick

Thanks, Jasmine. I looked at the attached p95 and the token CSV. Quick findings: 
- The p95 jump lines up with an increase in long-context document summarization requests (avg seq len jumped ~2.5x in late June). That increases KV-cache pressure and kernel scheduling overhead per request.
- Token mix: 70% of June spend is on the high-capacity generator model (r-instruct-xl) used by a single internal service. A ~10% routing shift to the same-size quantized variant (r-instruct-xl-q4) could cut tokens billed at higher unit cost due to model pricing differences and reduce latency variance.

Operational proposal (ops + infra):
- Short term: enable dedicated reserved capacity for the service that is producing long-context workloads (gives consistent GPU locality); add a small hot-cache tier and increase batch flush timeout to reduce KV misses.
- Medium term: we recommend targeted prompt engineering and model pinning for the high-volume flow; Ben can run a 2-week pilot on dedicated capacity (we can fund a portion as a one-time burst credit).

I’ve attached a one-page ops remediation checklist. If you’re open to it, we can sketch committed capacity levels that map to a p95 SLA and a price-per-token that drops with commit size.

Ben
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Attachment: ops_remediation_checklist.pdf

Date: Sat, 07 Jul 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + recent latency uptick

Lucas — attaching a draft mutual action plan and a term matrix with three options: 1) 12m conservative commit (moderate discount + burst credits), 2) 12m launch-ready commit (higher commit, p95 SLA, reserved pool for launch windows), 3) 24m strategic commit (largest discount, quarterly ROI checkpoints).

Key economics note: moving to a committed monthly GPU-backed capacity reduces your effective per-token price on the high-capacity generator by ~22% at the launch-ready level. We can model true ROI if you share expected Q4 throughput (tokens/day).

Next actions:
- Lucas: confirm which option you want us to model (I can produce an itemized bill impact within 48 hours).
- Jasmine & Ben: schedule the 30-min walkthrough — propose Mon 09 Jul, 11:00-11:30 PT.

Thanks — Monica
Enterprise Contracts, Redwood Inference
